About this index. A directory of sport governing bodies and Olympic and Paralympic organisations, public-health physical-activity guidance, sport science and exercise medicine journals, research societies, university and hospital research programmes, strength and endurance training methods, mobility, rehabilitation and injury care, wearables and performance technology, sport media and fan platforms, and AI coaching, nutrition, recovery and analytics tools. Every entry links straight to the source. Build: 1000 resources across 12 categories (149 flagged as AI tools). Filtering runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded anywhere.

Placement is a guide, not a ruling. A resource that spans fields (say, a wearable that also handles nutrition) could equally sit in a neighbouring section. Use the search box and the category drop-down together to narrow things down.

Link reliability. Not every page could be opened from the build environment (outbound requests were blocked there), so some URLs may have moved, be paywalled or be region-restricted. Export the CSV and run a link checker, then replace any dead entries with “+ Add resource”.

Health & safety. This index is a directory, not medical advice. Training plans, supplement evidence and rehabilitation guidance change as research does — check the primary source and speak to a qualified professional before starting a programme, especially with injury, chronic illness or pregnancy.

Access & pricing. Free / freemium / paid / open-source labels are approximate: university subscriptions, student discounts, regional availability and team licences change often. Many “paid” journals are readable free through a library, and many “free” tools require an account or a compatible device.
